target_source: ∀ (R A B C : Type*) [Ring R] [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup B] [AddCommGroup C] [Module R A] [Module R B] [Module R C] (f : A →ₗ[R] B) (g : B →ₗ[R] C), Function.Injective f → Function.Exact f g → Function.Surjective g → List.TFAE [∃ s : C →ₗ[R] B, g.comp s = LinearMap.id, ∃ r : B →ₗ[R] A, r.comp f = LinearMap.id, ∃ e : B ≃ₗ[R] A × C, f = e.symm.toLinearMap.comp (LinearMap.inl R A C) ∧ g = (LinearMap.snd R A C).comp e.toLinearMap]
